statement: De Giorgi's conjecture in dimension eight. Proves De Giorgi's conjecture at its sharp dimension-eight endpoint: every entire C2 solution $`u:\mathbb R^8\to(-1,1)`$ of $`\Delta u=u^3-u`$ that is strictly increasing in one direction depends on only one linear coordinate. A stronger theorem classifies all stable entire solutions $`v:\mathbb R^7\to[-1,1]`$ as constant wells or planar transitions, without an energy-growth assumption.
